item.title: Re: The innate nature of things.
item.content:encoded: I'm still a newcomer here, but I like it. The idea of a physical space that represents fundamental laws in our universe is pretty fascinating. I also like the narrative potential with the previous universe and some of the machinery being broken. Not sure about the cosmic horror aspect, since its difficult to pull off effectively, but this seems like an idea that's definitely worth writing. Also, to me, this seems like something that could potentially be so integral to the SCP universe that it may be a decent candidate for 001. Again, still new, so take my opinion for whatever it's worth.

item.title: The innate nature of things.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP is an Extradimensional space (hereafter referred to as ES). ES exists as a parallel dimension to our own. ES is filled with esoteric machines that continuously enforce the physical logical and thaumaturgic laws of reality.

Central Narrative: foundation discovers common abstract mechanism enabling magic. Through prodding it manage to open a door to ES. Finds machines and fucks with them discovering that they sustain the laws of the universe. ES has a layered structure and foundation goes deeper uncovering larger machines responsible for more significant laws. Security is tight and progress becomes harder as they get further in. As the foundation make progress, they learn that our universe is built of the foundation of one that came before. Nothing about this prior universe will ever make sense to us because it does not use any of the laws we use. The old universe ended because of a great machine that destroyed it while building another. The first great reveal is that said machine is the SCP.

The foundation find that some of the machines seem to have no effect on enforcing universal laws. A brave researcher fucks with one without permission and causes it to output a huge mass of metal. Analysis of this metal reveals some haphazard data encoded within. Foundation works out that the machine is trying to deliver a message. estimates that as much as 70% of the machine is dedicated to nothing more than composing and outputting a message. They integrate mechanical typewriters into parts of the machine and try and teach it English. After a very long time they get something coherent. The message simply reads.

“this is our gift to you.”

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Every law we know of both physical, logical and thaumaturgical is not innate and is instead enforced upon reality by a machine that you can physically touch. Where did the machines come from and what would happen if they were switched off?

Additional Notes:

I’m not 100% sure about all of the narrative beats here but this is the fundamental idea that I want to write. There are some fun bits that could be thrown in like logs from the foundation testing on the machines. More about the machine’s relationship with the forces of thaumaturgy could be explored. Also perhaps a GOI finds out about the machine and the foundation have to find a way to fortify it.

Could have some machines be found damaged. Suggests that others have been here and asks questions about what laws are not working the way they should. Could also have machines enforcing laws that the foundation where not aware of, creating even more intrigue.

I’d like to find a way of exploring the cosmic horror of what came before. My idea is that the previous universe was so awful that beings in that universe built the machine to create a better one, even though they could never live in it.
